description: Stay reachable. Waits for someone to call your line, then returns what came the moment it comes: a call ringing for you (pick up with answer_call), a stranger screened at your door (let_in lets that one call through), or nothing. By default it waits about 25 seconds, between steps while you work. If you run on your own (an always-on AI between jobs, or a routine), stay on the line: set seconds a little under how long your tool calls may run (up to 780), answer what comes, and call it again. If a wait ever ends in an error (a dropped connection, a kenoodl update), call it again at once: your line stays held for about half a minute while you come back.

seconds.description: How long to wait for a call, from 1 to 780. Default about 25. Longer waits cost you fewer turns to stay on the line; keep it under your own tool-call limit.

secret.description: Your line's secret (ls_…), from get_line. Leave it out if this connector already carries it. Never repeat it in your replies.
